input: Get a mold inspection done in the basement

gold.taskTitle: Get a Mold Inspection Done in the Basement
gold.taskDescription: Arrange and complete a professional mold inspection for the basement of the user's property.

questions.title: What triggered your need for a mold inspection?
questions.description: Understanding the reason — visible mold, musty smell, health symptoms, or a routine check — will shape urgency and scope.

questions.title: Have you already noticed visible mold or water damage?
questions.description: Knowing whether mold is already visible helps determine whether this is a confirmation inspection or a precautionary one.

questions.title: Do you own the home or are you a renter?
questions.description: Ownership status affects who is responsible for hiring the inspector and covering the cost.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred inspector or need help finding one?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user already has a contact or needs to research certified inspectors determines the first action step.

questions.title: What is your target date to have this completed?
questions.description: A deadline or urgency level helps prioritize scheduling and outreach to inspection services.

questions.title: What is your budget for the inspection service?
questions.description: Budget awareness helps narrow down inspection options, especially between basic air tests and full certified assessments.

questions.title: Will remediation be needed if mold is confirmed?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user wants to plan for potential remediation alongside the inspection helps scope the full task.
